errors.evidence: The color in the legend for '抑制' is black, and the corresponding bars are dark blue/gray. '灰色' (gray) is an inaccurate description.

errors.text_span: “积极参与”的“激活”比例达到约65%
errors.evidence: The chart shows the '激活' (activation) percentage for '积极参与' (active participation) is nearly 100%, not approximately 65%.

errors.text_span: 而“爱护环境”的“激活”比例约为55%
errors.evidence: The chart shows the '激活' (activation) percentage for '爱护环境' (caring for the environment) is approximately 63%, not 55%.

errors.text_span: 例如“穿着服饰”、“个人卫生”和“爱护公物”的“激活”比例均在10%以下
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for two of the three categories mentioned. The activation for '穿着服饰' is approximately 18% and for '爱护公物' is approximately 12%, both of which are greater than 10%.
